title: AT&T Business Awards $50,000 Grand Prize to Mission Valley Track & Field Club to Expand Opportunities for Bay Area Youth and Families
summary: The 45-year-old nonprofit promoting life skills through track and field will receive $50,000, connectivity resources, and a feature in a She’s Connected by AT&T episode with soccer legend Kelley O’Hara.
